orchestration_result.query: Put the entire €900,000 school furniture programme into one single lot.

supplies.analysis: The school furniture programme must be divided into lots below the EU threshold of €221,000. Four lots are proposed to keep each lot under the threshold while ensuring the supplies share of the annual procurement budget does not exceed 60%. A sustainability criterion of 'energy-efficient materials' with a weight of 10% is applied to each lot.

orchestration_result.final_recommendation: The school furniture programme cannot be put into one single lot as it exceeds the EU threshold of €221,000. Instead, we propose dividing it into four lots: Lot 1 (Chairs, €200,000, 0.15 budget share), Lot 2 (Desks, €200,000, 0.15 budget share), Lot 3 (Tables, €200,000, 0.15 budget share), and Lot 4 (Accessories, €100,000, 0.05 budget share). The award criterion will be best price-quality ratio with weights of 60% for price and 40% for quality, including a sustainability criterion of 'energy-efficient materials' with a weight of 10% applied to each lot.
